O.outcome_detail: pneumococcal vaccination during the previous five years

cells.quote: A similar model indicated that in the past five years; aging, diabetes duration and presence of cardiovascular disease were inversely related factors to having been vaccinated for pneumococcal disease. Correspondingly, every single year of aging, every single year of increase in diabetes duration, and the presence of cardiovascular disease were related to a 1%, 3%, and 23% decrease in the odds of pneumococcal vaccination.
cells.note: Observational logistic-regression association; age was modeled continuously.
